evidence: Manual operator observation: /clear produced a new session and extension lifetime under the same host.
limitations: Selecting an arbitrary existing foreground session was not demonstrated.

evidence: The live queue snapshot RPC returned bounded counts.
The live background-task snapshot RPC returned bounded counts.
The pending-permission snapshot RPC returned a bounded count.
limitations: No API exposed a verified user acknowledgement/read state.
Whole-session idle is event-driven and requires production reconciliation.

evidence: Relevant host commands observed: autopilot, model, plan, rename.
limitations: No demonstrated extension API switched, created, or archived a foreground TUI session.
Command presence alone is not proof that a companion can drive the host UI.
Exact terminal window, tab, and pane targeting belongs to terminal adapter qualification.

evidence: Host-driven composer completion triggers were readable.
limitations: No demonstrated API focused or submitted the existing TUI composer draft.
session.send() is intentionally not accepted as a composer substitute.
No extension RPC demonstrated native voice start, stop, state, or dependency handling.

evidence: Pending permission requests were readable without installing a handler.
A supplemental disposable run enabled per-client permission event bridging without installing a decision handler.
limitations: A visible disposable TUI permission prompt did not emit permission.requested to the extension after event bridging reported success.
The SDK request ID does not prove that the exact prompt is visible in the selected terminal.
Approve/reject remains disabled until visible-request binding and concurrent response races are qualified.

evidence: Current model and bounded available-model metadata were read from the live session.
Interactive and plan mode were round-tripped and restored.
The current reasoning effort was written back and read without changing its value.
limitations: A different model was not selected, and next-turn inference semantics were not exercised.
Autopilot was not enabled by the probe.
